text.en:
When a Class Ability Charge is consumed:
Grants Class Ability Energy based on the number of Mods equipped and consumes active Armor Charge Stacks.  

Each Stack of Armor Charge is the equivalent of an additional Kickstart Mod.

Ability Energy gains with 1|2|etc. Mods equipped:
<pve/>13% | 16.7% | 23.4% | 31% | 37.5% | 41.2% | 44.4% | 46.8% | 48.7%
<pvp/>Ability Energy gains are halved(?) in PVP.

When a Class Ability Charge is fully consumed:
Grants Class Ability Energy based on the number of Mods equipped and consumes active Armor Charge Stacks.  

Each Stack of Armor Charge is the equivalent of an additional Kickstart Mod.

Ability Energy gains with 1|2|etc. Mods:
<pve/>[PVE] 12.9% | 17.15% | 23.4% | 31% | 37.8% | 42.5% | 45.8% | 48.2% | 50%
<pvp/>[PVP] 11.3% | 12.9% | 14.8% | 17.15% | 20% | 23.4% | 27.15% | 31% | 34.65%

When a Class Ability Charge is fully consumed:
Grants Class Ability Energy based on the number of Mods equipped and consumes active Armor Charge Stacks.  

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Class Ability Energy refunds.

Class Ability Energy gains with 1|2|etc. 'charges':
<pve/>[PVE] 12.9% | 17.15% | 23.4% | 31% | 37.8% | 42.5% | 45.8% | 48.2% | 50%
<pvp/>[PVP] 11.3% | 12.9% | 14.8% | 17.15% | 20% | 23.4% | 27.15% | 31% | 34.65%

When a Class Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Class Ability Energy.  

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Class Ability Energy refunds.

Class Ability Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
<pve/>[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
<pvp/>[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%
